services.desc: Providing affordable rental homes for families, seniors, and people with disabilities with low to moderate incomes. ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ Sign a new tenancy at Kingston Gardens 5, Heather Place B, or Salal Landing ​and receive one month free!​ Nearly 85% of our homes have two or more bedrooms, offering family-friendly living spaces and programs for residents of all ages, along with family-oriented amenities on site.​ Watch the video to see how we are shaping the future of non-market housing in the region.
